title_sq: Shitet, Apartament 2+1+2+blk, Kompleksi Green City – Astir, 250,000 Euro
description_sq:
Karakteristika te prones:
– Apartament 2+1+2
– Rruga Nexho Konomi
– Zona Astir/Green City
– Pallat i ri me ashensor
– Kati 3
– I mobiluar
– Siperfaqja Bruto 107m²
– Siperfaqja Neto 93m²
– Cmimi 250,000 Euro
Shitet Apartament 2+1, me siperfaqe 110m², i cili ndodhet ne katin e 3 ne nje pallat te ri me ashensor tek Green City, Astir.
Apartamenti ka organizim shume te rregullt dhe perbehet nga salloni i ndenjes, ambient gatimi, korridori, 2 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete dhe ballkoni.
Njëri nga tualetet ndodhet tek dhoma e gjumit dhe tjetri në ambientet kryesore të apartamentit. Te dy tualetet jane me dritare.
Apartamenti shitet i mobiluar si ne foto. Eshte i shtruar me parket, i pajisur me kondicionere, lavastovilje dhe te gjitha elektroshtepiaket e nevojshme.
Pallati ndodhet ne nje zone e cila i ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme.
Hapësira e jashtme përbëhet nga lulishte me 2 pishina private si dhe kënde lojërash dhe parkingje apo garazhe private, furra buke, supermarkete, bar kafe, farmaci etj.
Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor. Shitet dhe me financim kredie.
Per me shume informacione ose per nje vizite ne prone kontaktoni ne numrin e agjencise imobiliare!
title_en: For sale, Apartment 2+1+2+blk, Green City Complex - Astir, 250,000 Euro
description_en: Property characteristics: - Apartment 2+1+2 - Nexho Konomi Street - Astir/Green City area - New building with elevator - 3rd floor - Furnished - Gross area 107m² - Net area 93m² - Price 250,000 Euro 2+1 apartment for sale, with an area of 110m², located on the 3rd floor of a new building with elevator to Green City, Astir. The apartment has a very regular organization and consists of a living room, a kitchen, a corridor, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. One of the toilets is located in the bedroom and the other in the main premises of the apartment. Both toilets have windows. The apartment is sold furnished as in the photo. It is paved with parquet, equipped with air conditioners, dishwashers and all the necessary electrical appliances. The palace is located in an area that offers all the necessary facilities. The outdoor space consists of flower gardens with 2 private swimming pools as well as playgrounds and parking lots or private garages, bakeries, supermarkets, coffee bars, pharmacies, etc. Has regular mortgage documentation. It is also sold with credit financing. For more information or for a visit to the property, contact the number of the real estate agency!
